NoteTexAccessor::strip_space¶

Back to Note TeX Accessor API Reference

Signature¶

Note NoteTexAccessor::strip_space() const

Remove Explicit TeX Spacing Syntax¶

strip_space() removes authored spacing controls while retaining neighboring visible content. It recognizes the control symbols \,, \;, \:, \!, \ , and \/; the exact control words \quad, \qquad, \enspace, \thinspace, \medspace, and \thickspace; balanced \hspace{...} and \vspace{...} calls, including starred forms; and the first dimension token after \vskip.

Removed syntax contributes a separator before ASCII whitespace is collapsed and the cell is trimmed. This avoids accidentally joining tokens such as left\quad right. The method removes spacing instructions, not all source whitespace and not visible delimiter-size commands. Use strip_lr() or strip_size() for those separate concerns.

Matching is lexical and exact. A doubled backslash protects the following text, longer names such as \quadratic remain, and an incomplete balanced argument is retained rather than partially consumed. The operation is out-of-place, shape preserving, and idempotent. Undefined state propagates; defined non-Text input rejects. Each cell is scanned once, with temporary storage bounded by the balanced argument depth.

Example 1: Control Symbols, Words, And Dimension Calls¶

const auto source = pluss::make_note({
    R"(a\,b\;c\:d\!e\ f\/g\quad h\qquad i)",
    R"(x\hspace*{1{e}m}y\vspace{2pt}z\vskip 3pt q)",
    R"(\\quad \quadratic \hspace{unfinished)"});
std::cout << source.tex().strip_space() << '\n';

Output¶

Note(shape=[3], dim=1, numel=3, encoding=utf8)
["a b c d e f g h i", "x y z q", "\\\\quad \\quadratic \\hspace{unfinished"]

Example 2: Matrix Shape And Empty Cells¶

const auto grid = pluss::make_note(
    std::vector<std::string>{R"(a\,b)", "plain", R"(c\quad d)", ""},
    std::array<std::int64_t, 2>{2, 2});
std::cout << grid.tex().strip_space() << '\n';

Output¶

Note(shape=[2, 2], dim=2, numel=4, encoding=utf8)
[
  ["a b", "plain"],
  ["c d", ""]
]

Example 3: Idempotence, Undefined State, And Dtype¶

const auto once = pluss::make_note(R"(a\quad b)").tex().strip_space();
std::cout << std::boolalpha
          << "idempotent="
          << ((once == once.tex().strip_space()).all().bool_item())
          << " undefined="
          << pluss::Note::undefined().tex().strip_space().defined() << '\n';
try {
  (void)pluss::note::make(std::vector<std::int64_t>{1}).tex().strip_space();
} catch (const pluss::Error&) {
  std::cout << "strip space Int64: rejected\n";
}

Output¶

idempotent=true undefined=false
strip space Int64: rejected
